items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: He added myself and Cootie Williams on trumpet to the band, which enlarged it to ten pieces.

ctx.x: Well, I was telling you about the time I went with Chick's band, Chick Webb. He had an eight-piece band at the Savoy Ballroom, and he was enlarging the band to ten pieces. And he added myself and Cootie Williams on trumpet to the band, which enlarged it to ten pieces.

Cootie was a trumpet player that came here with Alonzo Ross's band from Florida. And they fell into hard times, and the band broke up -- and they had some pretty good musicians in the band. They had a trumpet player named Melvin Herbert, who was a very good trumpet player, and then Cootie Williams. Then they had a well-known guitar player, Casper Cowie(?) was his name, and he later shortened it to Cass Carr.
